The '''Endor Space Station''', formally '''Imperial Research Station: 626''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
Serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Research Outpost|Research Station]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], this station would provide emergency repairs or clear [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for landing on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="SWG:ESS" />
